summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation as registrant for the Select Notes Trust LT 2003-2, reporting a distribution to certificate holders on the June 15, 2026 distribution date. The filing includes a trustee's report showing zero interest received and distributed during the interest period. It contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. The filing is a standard current report for an asset-backed security trust's periodic distribution, with no special situation elements triggering any of the defined categories. What to watch: none, as this is a routine pass-through filing.
